title: Separate semantic task failure from invalid tool protocol
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth needs cross-harness evaluation to classify invalid tool names and schema errors separately from simply getting the task wrong. Accepts FineEnvs out-of-harness failure modes[^fineenvs-xharness].
implementation: `CrossHarnessFailure` and `classify_cross_harness_failure` in `mechaharness.cross_harness_failure` emit taxonomy kinds usable as claims inside matrix cells.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — leaving native harness
